findings.title: St. Joseph Warren Hospital ending labor and delivery services
findings.publisher: WKBN 27 First News (full local report syndicated via AOL)
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Labor and delivery services currently provided at Mercy Health St. Joseph Warren Hospital will be discontinued by early December.
findings.access_consequences: Mercy Health has confirmed that labor and delivery at St. Joseph Warren Hospital will end by early December 2026, with hospital deliveries consolidated at St. Elizabeth Boardman Hospital. Local prenatal and postpartum care will continue; the Warren maternity space will become a 25-bed inpatient unit. Patients who previously delivered at the Warren site must use the Boardman location or another maternity provider; specific travel time and last service day are unverified.
findings.affected_population: Pregnant patients and families relying on hospital labor and delivery services in Warren and surrounding Trumbull County, Ohio.

checked_candidate_sources.detail: Mercy Health confirms early-December closure of Warren labor and delivery and transfer of deliveries to St. Elizabeth Boardman. Report was published earlier October 28 and updated 00:50 UTC October 29 (17:50 PDT October 28); this predates the current 19:43–20:46 PDT observation window. Exact closure day unknown. No production dedup verified.
Official notice shows board initiated discontinuation process August 25, 2026, with intended December 31 cessation; no new October 28 change established.
Sanford Luverne maternity closure was already in 11:51 PDT verified watch heartbeat.
Roseland maternity closure effective October 31 had been announced earlier; October 28 follow-up did not establish a new decision.
October 17 notice on October 19 clinics closure is outside the observation window.
Decatur air-medical base closure occurred in September.
